description: One row per detector, saying when it last completed and how many times it has. The sequence is monotonic and never resets, so a watcher outside this host can tell 'still running' from 'stopped', and 'stopped' from 'someone restored an older copy of the database'.

fields.label: Sequence
fields.description: Increments on every completed run and never goes backwards. A gap means runs were missed; a decrease means the record was replaced.

fields.label: Expected Every (s)
fields.description: How often this detector is scheduled. What 'late' means is derived from this rather than from one global guess.

name: Ingest Heartbeat
